page.overview:
Who is Spook?

Spook is a skaa Misting on Scadrial in the Final Empire and works inthumb Kelsier's crew. His original name is Jedal, after his father, but goes by Lestibournes before Kelsier gives him his nickname of Spook. The name Lestibournes is a reference to the Eastern street slang phrase, 'lefting I'm born', which means 'I've been abandoned'. He is a Tineye, and is Clubs' nephew. He is fifteen during the Collapse. He mentions to Beldre that in his family it had been his grandfather who had had noble blood. Although it is not mentioned explicitly it is likely that it was his grandfather on his mother's side, as Clubs was also an Allomancer. He also mentions that he never knew his grandfather, having grown up on the streets.
